title: Kusikiliza kwa Kina (Theme 2: Mazoezi ya viungo vya mwili)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child hears the one feature that separates /b/ na /mb/ and checks the meaning of the word before writing it.

floor.prerequisite: Says the five vowels and reads open syllables (ba, be, bi, bo, bu).
floor.question: Soma: ba-li

representations: a hand on the throat to feel the voice (or the lips for a nasal)
a picture for each meaning (but, far)
steps: Think of the meaning in the sentence.
Write it and read it back.
contexts: a word game in the playground

board.do: Point at the first letter of each word.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes both words under their pictures and says each one.

misconceptions.ask: Neno "bali" lina maana gani, na "mbali" lina maana gani?
misconceptions.repair: "bali" ni but; "mbali" ni far. Sauti moja hubadilisha maana.
Neno lenye maana ya "a shoulder" ni "bega". "mbega" lina maana ya "a colobus monkey".

misconceptions.ask: Ukibadilisha neno moja kwa jingine katika sentensi, maana inabaki ileile?
misconceptions.repair: Hapana. "bega" ni a shoulder, na "mbega" ni a colobus monkey.

misconceptions.ask: Ni sauti gani zinarudiwa katika sentensi hii?
misconceptions.repair: Kitanzandimi hurudia sauti zinazokaribiana, kama /b/ na /mb/, ili kiwe kigumu kutamka.

misconceptions.ask: Kila silabi inaishia kwa herufi gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: mba-li.

checks.question: Andika neno lenye maana ya "a colobus monkey".
Ni kipi ni kitanzandimi?
checks.answer: Mbega mbele ya mbuzi alibeba mbegu mbili mbichi mbugani.
